[Apple](https://www.apple.com/)’s iPhone 17 is reportedly seeing strong demand on its first day of availability.

The latest generation of the iPhone lineup, including [iPhone 17](https://www.apple.com/iphone-17/), [iPhone Air](https://www.apple.com/iphone-air/), [iPhone 17 Pro](https://www.apple.com/iphone-17-pro/) and [iPhone 17 Pro Max](https://www.apple.com/iphone-17-pro/), launched in Apple Store locations worldwide as well as online and in the Apple Store app Friday (Sept. 19), according to a company [announcement](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2025/09/the-latest-iphone-apple-watch-and-airpods-arrive-in-apple-store-locations/).
